snippet.title: Defending the Mall Final Trailer - Henry Stickmin Fangame
snippet.description:
As if Black Friday isn't stressful enough, Henry Stickmin finds himself trapped inside the West Orange Pavillion Mall after a group of thieves take a hostage. Will Henry rise to the occasion and be a hero, call for backup, or run away? You decide, in Defending the Mall!

___________

There ya have it folks, a November 8th release date! Working on Defending the Mall has been an absolute joy over the past 14 months, and I cannot believe the game is about to be out for everyone to play! Thank you all so much for all the love and support shown not just to my first trailer, but to updates I've given over the course of development!

I'm going to make a follow-up video on this, but please remember, this is a Henry Stickmin FANgame, not an official one! I'm the singular developer on this project, and as such, I ask that people reasonably set their expectations. This isn't the size of say, Fleeing the Complex or Completing the Mission, but it isn't as small as something like Escaping the Prison either. 

___________

Final Game: https://gamejolt.com/games/Defending_the_mall/1026799

Defending the Mall Trailer 1: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0u9TCRMxd0U

Follow on Gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/Defending_the_mall/1026799

Discord for Henry Stickmin Fangames: https://discord.gg/AjVnDDDDv

Credit to PuffballsUnited for the Henry Stickmin collection and music used!
